work.title: Design 004 independent acceptance remediation D01-D04
authority: Direct user instruction to implement D01-D04 from the independent Design 004 acceptance report.
Project Redwood invariant: unreconciled differences remain visible and are never silently forced to balance.

intent.productGoal: Keep the isolated Design 004 presentation trustworthy when canonical run data differs from the original reference run.
intent.capability: Fail closed for incomplete release bindings and invalid API responses, state materiality honestly, and render A/R review and decision narratives from the canonical A/R control identity and its own state.
architecturalIntent: Design 004 remains a read-only, isolated static presentation using GET /api/runs/:id as its sole financial authority.
The presentation must not infer release authority, materiality, or A/R semantics from missing fields, control ordering, or labels.
invariants: A release authorization display requires nonempty exact bindings to the canonical run, method profile, version, and dependency fingerprint.
Unreconciled controls remain separately visible; an A/R narrative only describes reconciliation id ar-to-gl.
A response with a mismatched identity or missing minimum canonical shape is not rendered as a canonical run and receives no local financial fallback.
acceptanceEvidence: Executable Node VM tests run the production design.js loader and renderers against the D01-D04 controlled variants.
Syntax, build, conformance schema, and protected-path diff checks complete without errors.

decisions.decision: Require every compared release binding to be a nonempty string before an approved release record can be displayed as authorization.
decisions.rationale: Equality of absent values is not evidence of an authority binding.

decisions.decision: Expose materiality summary as the explicit enum unavailable, unset, mixed, or recorded.
decisions.rationale: Missing or heterogeneous control state cannot safely be generalized as recorded materiality.

decisions.decision: Resolve A/R solely by canonical reconciliation id ar-to-gl and branch review and decision prose on that control's arithmetic and materiality state.
decisions.rationale: Control position and labels cannot authorize A/R-specific claims.

decisions.decision: Validate response object identity, scope, profile, and required collection fields before rendering.
decisions.rationale: A requested run must not be silently replaced by another or malformed response.

observedBehaviour: VM scenarios reject an API body whose id differs from the requested run and reject a body missing sourceInventory, rendering the explicit unavailable state instead.
VM scenarios render missing materiality as unavailable, all-unset as unset, heterogeneous valid statuses as mixed, and a uniform assessed state as recorded.
With a cash residual first and a matched ar-to-gl control, Review and Decision render A/R arithmetic agreement and do not describe the cash residual as A/R or state that A/R remains unresolved.
VM release scenarios keep authorization unverified when matching version or fingerprint values are omitted, null, or empty.

evidence.result: Passed: 6 named production-design.js VM tests, including all D01-D04 scenarios.
Passed before the final evidence record was written.

evidence.result: No diff; prohibited backend, root, next, and workbook surfaces are unchanged.

divergences.expected: D01-D04 controlled runtime behaviours are covered by executable VM tests.
divergences.observed: VM tests prove loader and generated-markup behaviour but not browser layout, focus traversal, or live API persistence.

learning.recurringPattern: Presentation authority claims require positive evidence for every identity component; equality alone is insufficient when fields may be absent.
learning.improvementProposal: If Design 004 becomes a supported route, formalize the GET run response contract and add browser-level accessibility coverage separately.
durableKnowledge: The Design 004 materiality summary contract is unavailable | unset | mixed | recorded.
The canonical A/R presentation identity is reconciliation id ar-to-gl; label and list order are not authority.
